# Cordis — TypeScript reproduction (generated by PaperCoder)

A TypeScript re-implementation of **"A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal
Composability"** (Shi, Zhang & Cui — Peking University / DeepSeek-AI), generated
end-to-end by the PaperCoder multi-agent pipeline (Planning → Analyzing →
Coding) using `deepseek-v4-flash`.

## What's here

| Area | Files | Implements (paper §) |
|---|---|---|
| Core context | `src/context.ts`, `src/effect.ts`, `src/coeffect.ts` | first-class context `Γ∞`, revertible effects (Algorithm 1), reactive coeffects (Algorithms 2–3) |
| Fiber lifecycle | `src/fiber.ts`, `src/lifecycle.ts` | inertial state machine, guarded withdrawal, committed-view fixity, failure recovery (§4, Algorithms 4–5) |
| Loader | `src/loader.ts` | declarative reconciliation, managed isolation realms (Algorithm 7) |
| HMR | `src/hmr.ts` | module classification, stale detection, transactional reload (Algorithms 8–10) |
| Tests | `tests/core.test.ts`, `tests/property.test.ts` | 10 core tests + 6 `fast-check` properties (recovery exactness, activation/withdrawal ordering, resolution coherence, progress, confluence) |
| Demo | `main.ts` | end-to-end smoke test: activation order, cascaded unload, reactive re-activation, HMR swap |
| Config | `config.yaml`, `UNCLEAR_ASSUMPTIONS.md` | the planner's configuration and the human-in-the-loop assumptions record |

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit (clean)
npm test            # 16/16 passing
npm start           # smoke test (prints fiber inventories, exits 0)
```

## Notes

- Generated from the paper's PDF via `tools/pdf_to_s2orc_json.py` in the parent
  repository; runtime artifacts of the pipeline run live in `../outputs/Cordis/`.
- A few invariants were hardened during verification (per-fiber binding
  ownership, per-context-tree registries, transactional HMR rollback) — see
  `UNCLEAR_ASSUMPTIONS.md`.
